_comment: Which of mxm-classic-verb's parameters fill the collection's control roles.
Roles come from docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md, which is normative; parameters are named by
their permanent string id, never by display name.
Mix fills the existing fx.reverb role: it is how much reverb is in what you hear.
The seven dedicated roles occupy page 13, Classic verb, in the brief's order - Space, Decay,
Size, Pre-delay, Bass decay, Treble decay, Decay shape - and leave its eighth slot free
Diffusion, Mod depth, Mod rate, Width, Low tone, High tone, Early and late and Ducking are
shape controls, set once for a space rather than played while the effect runs. They stay
unmapped, automatable and on the panel.
